work: Room drafts were bridge with a storm wedge, wet_lab with a dense pump bank, dry_lab with a quiet monitor wall, mess_hall with a long supper table, medical_bay with an exam couch, crew_quarters with a cabin corridor, editing_room with a monitor and camera gear, and engineering_workshop with a tool wall. Portrait drafts were thomas_blake counting consequences, sarah_morgan listening at attention, maya_chen drawing a patient explanation, daniel_reyes demonstrating with a part, olivia_hart waiting through a pause, and lucas_weber recalling a gesture. In the first comparison, wet_lab and engineering_workshop both read as dense machinery, so I gave the lab looping water lines and the shop a rigid tool grid. Dry_lab and editing_room both read as monitor rooms, so I gave the former aligned data traces and the latter an illuminated camera edge. Medical_bay and crew_quarters both read as narrow white interiors, so I turned the exam bed across the frame and gave the corridor a shadowed dogleg. Thomas_blake and maya_chen both led with an explaining hand, so I separated his reclined finger count from her forward pencil sweep. Sarah_morgan and olivia_hart both had listening poses, so I gave Sarah a standing profile turn and Olivia a seated direct gaze. In the second comparison, wet_lab and engineering_workshop still shared a high viewpoint and dense equipment, so I moved the shop to the doorway and emphasized its overhead cable trays. Dry_lab and editing_room still shared screen light, so I raised the editing view above the desk. Thomas_blake and olivia_hart still shared direct gaze and soft light, so I cropped Olivia at the bust, where her crossed forearms read against Thomas’s hip-up counting gesture.

rooms.description: A raked corner window cuts across the view, framing a heel of grey sea. Angled radar and weather screens flank a clipped log sheet, a radio in its cradle and a noticeboard pinned at every corner.
rooms.feeling: The squared log sheet makes the watch feel methodical while the tilted sea makes standing still feel precarious.

rooms.description: Look down through looping black water lines onto steel benches and graphite anti-slip flooring. Ceiling strips bloom in condensation above the sampling manifold, where pump housings and bottles locked into yellow collars crowd a freshly scrubbed drain.
rooms.feeling: The freshly scrubbed drain shows the lab crew’s care even as pump vibration shivers through the wash water.

rooms.description: From the back corner, an uninterrupted bench leads toward a short wall of staggered monitors showing thin blue traces. Clamped keyboard trays repeat beneath them, and one scientific sketch sits pinned squarely beside a screen.
rooms.feeling: The carefully aligned sketch suggests patient analysis, while a single erratic trace unsettles the room’s silence.

rooms.description: At bench height, a narrow rectangular table leads to the galley’s latched refrigerator. An amber bulkhead lamp warms a clamped coffee urn, personal mugs clipped under a shelf and snapshots pinned above the bolted bench.
rooms.feeling: The clipped mugs give everyone a place here, while the crowded bench feels strangely exposed in the quiet between meals.

rooms.description: An exam bed spans the doorway view, its blanket tucked under a retaining strap. A broad ceiling diffuser lights latched white cabinets, a swung-in diagnostic screen and a report desk with two identical pens clipped side by side.
rooms.feeling: The medic’s paired pens make the room feel prepared for anything, while the tucked blanket makes it feel unexpectedly gentle.

rooms.description: Tall jambs narrow the short passage before it doglegs. Two near cabin doors and a sliver of a third catch a low ceiling glow. A red nameplate backing and a ribbon knotted flat to a latch break the repetition.
rooms.feeling: The knotted ribbon gives one anonymous berth a personal marker, while the tight passage makes privacy feel thin.

rooms.description: From above the desk corner, a strapped camera cuts diagonally across the laptop’s glow. Two edge-on monitors silhouette docked headphones and charging blocks, while a violet clip holds one pinned shot strip apart from the others.
rooms.feeling: The isolated shot strip shows where the editor’s attention has settled, even as the crowded charging dock suggests someone ready to move.

rooms.description: Overhead cable trays rise above a green vise and a rail-mounted test meter. A bare LED bar casts hard wrench shadows across a slotted rack, with a pinned diagram and bolted maintenance terminal beneath.
rooms.feeling: The wrenches are clipped in exact size order even as the cable trays carry a steady industrial rattle.

people.description: A broad, compact man in his fifties with full cheeks and neatly parted black hair leans back in a pressed shirt and square knit vest. He meets your eye and counts on two fingertips above a frayed mustard cuff.
people.feeling: He counts practical consequences on his fingertips while a frayed cuff interrupts the polish of his pitch.

people.description: Tall and straight-backed, with a long dark braid and a lined, angular face, the captain turns one ear toward the speaker. Hard light catches her navy duty shirt and the thumb rubbing its side seam.
people.feeling: She turns an ear toward the speaker and waits before answering, while a restless thumb betrays the effort of standing so still.

people.description: Broad through the hips, with rounded cheeks and a straight black fringe over a low ponytail, she leans into warm light in a canvas overshirt and rust henley. One finger follows a diagram while the other taps its far corner.
people.feeling: She traces the diagram at the listener’s pace while her free finger keeps tapping the conclusion.

people.description: A lean, long-armed man in his late fifties turns sideways in a grease-marked drill shirt. His clean-shaven jaw and close black hair catch hard light as he rolls a bearing between thumb and forefinger with delicate care.
people.feeling: He rolls the bearing between two fingers to explain it in everyday terms, handling it more delicately than his abrupt delivery suggests.

people.description: A round-faced woman in her early forties with dark skin and close twists sits with her forearms crossed loosely over a plum cardigan. Soft sidelight catches her steady eyes as she leaves space after a question.
people.feeling: She lets a pause sit long enough for someone to fill it, her gaze inviting an answer even as her crossed forearms keep a little distance.

people.description: Compact, with a cleft chin and straight brown hair shaved close at the sides, he hunches in a fitted moss shell. Screen glow catches his raised elbow as he presses a knuckle to his temple and looks up.
people.feeling: He presses a knuckle to his temple to recall where someone’s hands were, and his restless shoulders go suddenly still.
